news.title: OpenClaw's ChatGPT moment sparks concern that AI models are becoming commodities
news.description: At Nvidia's GTC conference this week, CEO Nvidia Jensen Huang dedicated a major part of his keynote to OpenClaw, a technology that didn't exist six months ago.

news.title: Former special counsel Robert Mueller has died at 81
news.description: Robert Mueller, the former special counsel who investigated Russian interference in the 2016 presidential election, died Friday.

news.title: Trump threatens to deploy ICE agents to airports if DHS shutdown doesn't end, while Elon Musk offers to cover TSA agents' pay
news.description: President Trump claimed ICE agents handling airport security would arrest immigrants who are in the U.S. illegally.
